scope: P10 bounded music publisher recovery after an unexpected LiveKit disconnect.
implemented: An unexpected publisher disconnect first snapshots the interrupted track and pending queue as an inactive paused session.
The server retries publication with a bounded 0ms, 500ms, 1s and 2s schedule and a 12-second timeout per attempt.
A successful reconnect consumes the restored queue once and resumes through the normal single play loop without duplicating queue entries.
Exhausted retries leave the durable queue paused for the user's explicit restore action instead of reporting false playback.
Explicit stop, channel-empty teardown and graceful shutdown do not invoke automatic reconnect.
remaining: A real LiveKit interruption must verify audible recovery, stable participant identity and absence of accelerated samples with two clients.
Packaged Windows network-loss recovery remains an acceptance gate.
release: Source and automated fixtures only; no commit, push, merge, deployment or Windows update was performed.
